title: Hosted API: soft-quarantine and smart-replay guard for escalated tenants
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: During a high-severity customer escalation on 2026-03-07 we observed repeated waves of 5xx errors and client-observed timeouts originating from a small set of tenants. Investigation pointed to retry amplification + KV cache churn on the serving runtime causing request processing tails and inflight connection queuing. This ticket implements a short-term runtime-level soft-quarantine for noisy tenants and a smart-replay guard that prevents identical idempotent replays from amplifying downstream load.

Why different from prior tickets: previous work focused on backpressure and global retry throttles. This approach targets graceful degradation at the tenant scope while preserving low-latency fast-path for healthy tenants and minimizing false positives that would disrupt customer UX. It also coordinates with SDK retry semantics to avoid breaking idempotent guarantees.

Scope: design, implement, and rollout (canary -> staged) a tenant soft-quarantine controller in the edge/ingress layer, plus a stateless replay-deduplication guard in the request admission path. Provide console visibility (per-tenant quarantine reason, start/end, metrics) and an operator runbook for escalation/rescind.

Trade-offs and constraints:
- Soft-quarantine will reject heavy non-idempotent requests after a short sampled probation window; we accept short-lived partial denials to protect the fleet.
- Dedup guard is intentionally conservative (10s window) to avoid false dedupes for long-lived client retry schemes. May need tuning after canary.
- Implementation must avoid large state stores; prefer bounded in-memory LRU + optional Redis backing for cross-replica coordination.

Stakeholders: oncall (runtime), infra (edge), solutions (customer comms), PM (Lena Ortiz), SRE (runbooks), Legal/Security if customer-side encrypted payloads are affected.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime ingress can mark a tenant as 'soft-quarantined' without requiring a full deployment restart
Quarantined tenants see clear 429/445 object responses with structured JSON explaining reason and retry-after
Dedup guard suppresses >75% of identical idempotent replays during a synthetic amplification test without increasing successful error-rate for baseline tenants
Console shows per-tenant quarantine events with timestamps and aggregated metrics (requests/sec, reject-rate, kv-cache-evictions), and these are queryable by customer_id
Canary rollout to 5% of edge nodes shows no increased error-rate for non-target tenants over 48h
Runbook created and validated by oncall: steps to enable/disable quarantine, read console metrics, escalate to eng
steps_taken: 2026-03-07: Triage call with oncall, product, and customer success to confirm impact window and customer observed behavior
2026-03-08: Correlated traces and KV cache eviction logs; identified tenant hotspots and client retry storms from SDK v2.3.1
2026-03-09: Implemented emergency edge-level rate cap as stopgap (manual toggle) to stabilize latency for 12 hours
2026-03-10: Prototype smart-replay dedupe using request fingerprint (model+prompt-hash+idempotency_token) with 10s LRU in ingress; validated against synthetic harness
2026-03-12: Drafted API responses spec for quarantine (429 + structured reason + optional fallback instructions) and console UI wireframe with Design
2026-03-13: Opened PRs for ingress quarantine controller and dedupe filter; created canary toggle and telemetry events
monitoring_queries: sql: SELECT tenant, count(*) as inflight FROM request_queue WHERE state='inflight' GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY inflight DESC LIMIT 20
comments: 2026-03-09 - Aisha Patel: Captured initial analysis; high correlation between retry storms and KV cache compaction events. Proposed tenant soft-quarantine prototype.
2026-03-10 - Marco Nguyen: Built prototype dedupe filter and ran against replay harness. Early results: 68% reduction in repeat inflight requests for test tenant.
2026-03-11 - Priya Shah (SRE): Observed no regressions in sampling canary after edge cap. Need console metrics for quarantine events before wider rollout.
2026-03-12 - Lena Ortiz (PM): Confirmed messaging and customer comms template; wants 48h canary metrics before approving staged rollout.
2026-03-13 - Marco Nguyen: PRs opened, canary toggle added to infra config. Next: schedule a 2-hour canary and monitor the dashboard.
resolution_summary: (in progress) Expected outcome: contain tenant-driven 5xx/timeouts by limiting amplification vectors at ingress while preserving fast-path for healthy tenants. If canary passes, staged rollout to 25% then 100% over up to 7 days with telemetry-driven rollback gates.
additional_notes: Coordinate SDK team to publish recommended retry backoff for customers and add header to indicate dedupe detection (X-RW-Dedupe: true) to help clients differentiate dedup suppression from genuine failures. Consider longer-term: persist small dedupe bloom filter in a lightweight Redis cluster for cross-replica suppression if single-node LRU misses prove common.
